long_biography.plain_text:
Rocco Scarfone worked in Greensboro nightlife before acquiring the surviving Ham's restaurant business after its bankruptcy. The purchase put him in charge of a familiar regional name, which he tried to revive through updated premises and new dining formats. The last Ham's location closed in 2022, ending that chapter of his restaurant career.

He also developed live-entertainment spaces with partners. Scarfone held a majority membership and management role in the venture behind Cone Denim Entertainment Center, a downtown Greensboro concert venue. With Jeffrey Furr he led F&S Restaurant Group, which pursued restaurant franchising alongside its existing dining and entertainment brands. His career crossed between restaurants and nightlife rather than remaining tied to one concept.
